texture.name: Prague Texture Segmentation Benchmark
texture.fit: Best match for the paper's texture experiments: benchmark texture mosaics with corresponding ground-truth and mask images.
texture.image_selection_rule: After terms review, choose a small reviewed subset of benchmark texture mosaics that have corresponding ground-truth segmentation labels.
texture.mask_mapping_rule: Convert each matching ground-truth label or mask image to a label PNG with the same relative path and extension as the input mosaic.
conversion_checklist: Save the raw downloaded archive or source-file bundle under texture/audit/ and record it as source_artifact_path.
Convert the texture mosaic to grayscale or single-channel PNG without resizing unless the conversion notes explicitly record the change.
Convert the paired ground-truth labels to an integer-valued PNG and verify that it has at least two labels and the same shape as the image.
Run --refresh-manifest-file-claims and --refresh-source-audit-artifact-claims after placing the PNG and audit files.
texture.license_note: Use only files allowed by the benchmark terms; keep downloaded archives local unless license-safe.

medical.name: BrainWeb Simulated Brain MRI Database
medical.fit: Stable MRI-like source with simulated volumes and anatomical labels; suitable for grayscale multiclass segmentation before using heavier clinical datasets.
medical.image_selection_rule: After terms review, download one simulated MRI volume and its matching anatomical/label volume, then select representative 2D slices.
medical.mask_mapping_rule: For each selected MRI slice, export the matching anatomical label slice to the same relative PNG path under medical/masks.
conversion_checklist: Keep the raw BrainWeb volume or downloaded payload under medical/audit/ and record its hash.
Normalize each selected MRI slice to grayscale PNG while recording modality, noise, slice index, and scaling in conversion_notes.
Export the corresponding anatomical labels as integer-valued PNG masks with identical dimensions.
Verify image/mask shape equality before running --strict-data-ready.
medical.license_note: Verify BrainWeb terms before redistributing; prefer keeping raw volumes local.

medical.name: TCIA Pretreat-MetsToBrain-Masks
medical.fit: Real brain MRI segmentations, but much larger and tumor/metastasis-specific; useful after BrainWeb.
medical.image_selection_rule: After TCIA terms and citation review, select a small matched image/segmentation case pair that can be converted locally.
medical.mask_mapping_rule: Export the selected segmentation mask to the same relative path and extension as the converted MRI slice.
conversion_checklist: Keep collection metadata, case id, and license/citation snapshots under medical/audit/.
Convert a matched DICOM/NIfTI image slice to grayscale PNG and record the tool, slice, windowing, and anonymized case id.
Convert the corresponding segmentation to an integer-valued PNG mask with the same shape.
Do not commit clinical image data unless redistribution terms are explicitly approved.
medical.license_note: Large clinical archive; check TCIA usage and citation requirements before committing derived assets.

cartoon.name: Berkeley Segmentation Dataset and Benchmark
cartoon.fit: Natural-image public substitute with human segmentations; useful for smooth-region / cartoon-like qualitative checks, but not the original paper cartoon data.
cartoon.image_selection_rule: After terms review, choose a small subset of BSDS images with smooth/cartoon-like regions and available human segmentation ground truth.
cartoon.mask_mapping_rule: Convert one reviewed human segmentation for each image into an integer label PNG with the same relative path and extension as the grayscale input image.
conversion_checklist: Keep the original image and ground-truth source bundle or manifest snapshot under cartoon/audit/.
Convert RGB images to grayscale PNG and record the conversion formula.
Convert the selected human segmentation labels to PNG and verify at least two labels and matching image shape.
Record the original BSDS image id and selected annotator/ground-truth id in conversion_notes.
cartoon.license_note: Use according to Berkeley dataset terms; keep original archives local unless redistribution is permitted.

cartoon.name: Weizmann Segmentation Evaluation Database
cartoon.fit: Small natural-image segmentation database with ground truth; useful as backup if BSDS setup is inconvenient.
cartoon.image_selection_rule: After research-use terms review, choose reviewed image/ground-truth pairs as a backup cartoon-like natural-image source.
cartoon.mask_mapping_rule: Convert each reviewed ground-truth segmentation to a label PNG with the same relative path as the grayscale image.
conversion_checklist: Save the download page, terms, and selected file list under cartoon/audit/.
Convert the input image to grayscale PNG and document the source filename.
Convert the matching segmentation to an integer label PNG with identical dimensions.
Use file-level source_audit overrides if images in one family come from mixed sources.
cartoon.license_note: Research-use disclaimer and image-source terms are restrictive; do not commit images without review.
